description: Optional declarative local-first memory and knowledge pack for session recall, user profile memory, project knowledge, skill-learning proposals, hygiene, and evidence-backed recall.

optional_dependencies.reason: Can schedule memory hygiene routines or background curation while this pack supplies policies and contracts.
Can provide evidence records that support memory recall and project knowledge claims.
Can load local agent prompts/profiles that consume memory and project knowledge guidance.

defaultspack.overlap: defaultspack may include concrete memory runtime surfaces; this pack defines declarative contracts, policies, and review schemas only.
defaultspack.conflict: none; defaultspack remains the runtime owner

rumi_agent_services_pack.overlap: agent services may schedule routines, cron-like jobs, or background curation; this pack defines memory hygiene recipes and policies but does not execute jobs.
rumi_agent_services_pack.conflict: none; service execution should reference memory policy ids explicitly

rumi_research_pack.overlap: research owns source evidence collection and citation workflows; memory knowledge owns recall, profile, project knowledge, and hygiene contracts.
rumi_research_pack.conflict: none; use research evidence cards as optional memory evidence

rumi_local_agent_pack.overlap: local agent prompts may mention memory and project context; this pack supplies memory policies and schemas without replacing local agent profiles.

existing_memory_surfaces.overlap: existing runtime memory stores, session search, and user profile surfaces remain implementation-owned.
existing_memory_surfaces.conflict: none; this pack must not write runtime memory

base_pack_promotion.reason: Memory knowledge pack augments defaultspack with contracts and policies and must not become the default runtime pack.

compatibility.notes: No executable memory writer, scheduler, gateway, or search index is included.
